title: निर्बन्ध उपन्यासको नारीवादी अध्ययन {Feminist Studies of the Essay Novel}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन निर्बन्ध उपन्यासको नारीवादी अध्ययनमा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । यस अध्ययनका लागि नारीवादी समालोचनका क्षेत्रमा प्रचलित कृतिभित्र पुरुष पात्रले नारीलाई हेर्ने दृष्टिकोण, नारीप्रतिको लेखकीय दृष्टिकोण, कृतिमा नारीले प्राप्त गरेको सामाजिक अधिकार, आर्थिक अधिकार, नागरिक तथा राजनीतिक अधिकार, सांस्कृतिक अधिकार, यौन तथा प्रजननअधिकारका साथै उपन्यासको कालगत, वर्गीय र उपन्यासको जातीय सन्दर्भको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । उपन्यासको प्रमुख पुरुष पात्रलाई परिवर्तन गर्न सफल हुनाले म पात्र नारीवादी दृष्टिले सबल देखियो भने अन्य पात्रहरू नारीवादी दृष्टिले दुर्बल पाइयो । आधारभूत मानवाधिकारका दृष्टिले हेर्दा म पात्रले सामाजिक अधिकार उपयोग गरेको पाइयो तर त्यो अधिकारको उपयोग नारीको सवाललाई सामाजिक परिवर्तनका रूपमा एकीकृत गरी उठाउन सकेको पाइएन । उपन्यासमा नायिकाकोआर्थिक र राजनीतिक स्वतन्त्रता छ तर अन्य पात्रले सो स्वतन्त्रता प्राप्त गर्न सकेका छैनन् । नायिका स्वतन्त्र यौन एवम्प्रजनन सम्बन्धी विशेष अधिकारप्रति सचेत देखिएको पाइएन । निर्बन्ध उपन्यासमा कालगत, वर्गीय र जातीय सन्दर्भ मध्ये कालगत दृष्टिले नारीवाद सबल देखिए पनि वर्गीय र जातीय दृष्टिले कमजोर देखियो । नायिकाले परापूर्वकालदेखि चलिआएको धर्म, संस्कृतिका कारण नारीमाथि गरिएको हिंसा विरुद्धको आफ्नो विद्रोह उत्तराद्र्धमा कमजोर बनाएको पाइएकाले यस उपन्यासमा नारीवादी विचारमा ठेस पुगेको देखियो ।
american_english: The present study is focused on a feminist study of the novel Nirbandha. For this study, the perspectives of male characters toward women within the work prevalent in the field of feminist criticism, the authorial perspective toward women, the social rights, economic rights, civil and political rights, cultural rights, and sexual and reproductive rights obtained by women in the work, as well as the temporal, class, and caste contexts of the novel, have been studied. Because of being successful in changing the primary male character of the novel, the first-person narrator character appeared strong from a feminist perspective, whereas other characters were found weak from a feminist perspective. Looking from the perspective of fundamental human rights, the first-person character was found to have utilized social rights, but the utilization of those rights could not be found to have raised women's issues by integrating them into social change. In the novel, the heroine has economic and political freedom, but other characters have not been able to achieve that freedom. The heroine was not found to appear conscious of special rights regarding autonomous sexual and reproductive matters. In the novel Nirbandha, among temporal, class, and caste contexts, although feminism appeared strong from a temporal perspective, it appeared weak from class and caste perspectives. As the heroine was found to have weakened in the latter half her rebellion against violence committed against women on account of religion and culture practiced since ancient times, feminist thought appeared to have suffered a setback in this novel.

informal_english: This study is focused on a feminist study of the novel Nirbandha. For this study, the perspectives of male characters toward women within the work prevalent in the field of feminist criticism, the authorial perspective toward women, the social rights, economic rights, civil and political rights, cultural rights, and sexual and reproductive rights obtained by women in the work, along with the novel's temporal, class, and caste contexts, have been studied. Because of being successful in changing the novel's main bloke, the first-person narrator character looked strong from a feminist perspective, whereas other characters turned out weak from a feminist angle. Looking from the perspective of basic human rights, the first-person character was found to make use of social rights, but using those rights couldn't really be seen to raise women's issues by integrating them into social change. In the novel, the heroine has got economic and political freedom, but other characters haven't been able to get that freedom. As the heroine was found to have weakened her rebellion in the second half against violence committed against women on account of religion and culture practiced since ancient times, feminist thinking seems to have taken a bit of a hit in this novel.
